title: run.yipyap.reply.alert.suppressed.v1
description: Silence matching alerts for a declared duration. Duration must be finite and bounded by channel policy.

alert_id.description: ID of the alert being suppressed. Must match ce_alertref on the reply envelope.

duration_seconds.description: How long to suppress this alert and matching alerts. Capped at the channel's max_suppress_seconds (default 3600).

reason.description: Human-readable justification (e.g. "known issue during deploy window"). Stored on the audit log.

match_filter.description: Optional fields restricting which future alerts this suppression covers. Absence means 'this exact alert only'. Fields: monitor_id (string), severity (string).
